description: Source code for a keyboard driver for Nuvoton NPCX hardware in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, initialization, and interrupt handling functions.

methods.name: npcx_kbd_ksi_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for keyboard scan input (KSI) events, triggers polling.

methods.name: npcx_kbd_set_detect_mode
methods.description: Enables or disables detection mode for keyboard input, manages wake-up IRQ.

methods.name: npcx_kbd_drive_column
methods.description: Sets the drive state of keyboard columns for scanning.

methods.name: npcx_kbd_read_row
methods.description: Reads the current state of keyboard rows.

methods.name: npcx_kbd_init_ksi_wui_callback
methods.description: Initializes wake-up input callback for KSI signals.

methods.name: npcx_kbd_init
methods.description: Initializes the keyboard driver, configures clocks, GPIO, and interrupts.
